card.name: Abbreviation or start before a number
card.fires_on: Short pieces right before a reference number or page figure, such as the period in S.787, 'c.' before a year, 'p.' or 'No.' before a number, and a degree sign before minutes. Also starts of capitalized names.

modes.label: Abbreviation before number
modes.description: A short abbreviation or punctuation mark that introduces a numeric reference.

modes.label: Start of a proper name
modes.description: The first piece of a capitalized name or title split into parts.

modes.label: Citation marker
modes.description: A page or manuscript marker in a scholarly citation.

card.writes: It promotes digits and spacing characters, so a number is expected next.
card.plain: It fires on short abbreviations in citations that are about to be followed by a number.
